row_identity: seed, episode_index (zero-based in the ordered run), step_index (zero-based within episode)
decision_state_t: decision_observation_json: exact 14-dimensional float32 policy observation before selecting action at step_index t
selected_action_a_t: selected_action_json: exact 2-dimensional normalized float32 action returned by the frozen TD-MPC2 planner from decision_state_t
applied_action: applied_action_json: 2-dimensional raw stEVE velocity action reported by the unchanged environment after normalized-action mapping
next_state: next_observation_json: exact 14-dimensional float32 observation returned by env.step(a_t)
force_target: distal_contact_force_max_N: maximum 3 mm distal resultant force over all SOFA substeps during the immediately following env.step(a_t) control interval
canonical_future_prediction_notation: F_(t+1) = max-substep distal force generated after decision state s_t and selected action a_t; the same CSV row stores s_t, a_t, s_(t+1), and F_(t+1)
distal_contact_count_definition: Maximum number of simultaneously active distal normal-contact groups among the 22 SOFA substeps of the control interval.
distal_contact_substeps_definition: Number of SOFA substeps in the control interval with at least one active distal normal-contact group.
reward_and_done_timing: reward, terminated, truncated, success_step, tip position, and insertion length are returned/observed after the same env.step(a_t)
latent_state: Not extracted in G2: obtaining an exact planner latent without introducing model hooks was not required for unambiguous observation/action/force alignment.
